days.mbo_verdict: TRADE-FLOW ONLY (book stood down). The flow read on this day is clean and it says one thing: an absorbed-sell structure that survived. Phase 1 was the only ALIGNED phase (+664 flow on +250 price - genuine buying lifting a thin overnight book after the seam overshoot). Phases 2 and 3 both ran flow NEGATIVE under a RISING price (-89 on +290, then -1,207 on +140) - the classic absorption signature, and ph_absorb flags the third. Under the working discriminator that is NEGATIVE-under-rising and would normally read as covering / round-trip risk. It did not round-trip: the close came at 0.99 of range. The reason it did not is the level - the whole session was climbing back out of a seam hole, so the 'rising price' being sold into was a recovery toward the prior close, not an extension away from it. That is the scoping this discriminator needs and did not have: NEGATIVE-under-rising means round-trip risk when the rise is an EXTENSION beyond the anchor, and means a bid defending a level when the rise is a RECOVERY toward it. On 0706 the price only crossed the anchor at 15:00 and closed 100 above it - almost the entire absorbed-sell phase happened below the prior close.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding: MY OWN LENS'S CORE PREMISE IS REFUTED ON THIS EVIDENCE. The lens file states: 'The 06-10 ET catch-up window is where Monday decides; the overnight session is drift that the US morning either ratifies or reverses.' I measured the 06:00-10:00 ET window's contribution on every Monday available across two staged groups, off the realized continuous curves. It is NEGATIVE ON ALL FOUR: g22 0622 -710, g22 0629 -510, g23 0706 -50, g23 0713 -360 (median -435). The two adjacent sub-periods each split 2-2 (pre-06: +500 / -490 / +390 / -100; 10-close: -350 / -160 / +340 / +200). The window is the ONLY sub-period of a Monday that is unanimous in sign, and it is unanimous in the sell direction - including on the two Mondays that closed UP on the day (0622 +650, 0706 +100), where the window traded against the day's own direction. On my day specifically the window contributed -50 of a +880 realized advance: the advance happened before it (overnight and early morning, +390 from the open to 06:00) and after it (+340 from 10:00 to the close). The window did not decide the day and it did not ratify anything. TWO CONSEQUENCES. (1) The lens's RATIFICATION arm is 0 for 2 and should be retired: on this evidence the US morning does not ratify a positive overnight, it sells into it. (2) The lens's real object is the SEAM, not the window - 100 percent of the block's gap risk sits on Mondays (weekday |gap| <= 20 across 16 seams; weekend |gap| 1,210 / 50 / 580 / 360), and on my day the gap error alone (980) was 2.45x the day-level error the blind was scored on. A Monday specialist whose attention is on 06-10 is watching the quietest four hours of his own day. THE CAVEAT THAT KEEPS THIS HONEST: g22 and g23 sit inside a single downtrend (3.319 -> 2.916), so a unanimous sell window may be a regime sample rather than a structure. The falsifier is explicit and cheap: an up-trending fortnight in which the Monday 06-10 window is positive on 2 or more Mondays.

proposal_contribution.preamble: TEXT ONLY. No brain edit is made or implied. Each item states its n, whether it spans groups, its scope, and its falsifier. Items with n=1 are labelled as hypotheses and are NOT offered as rules.

proposal_1.claim: In this continuously-traded tape the overnight gap is structurally zero on weekdays and material only across weekend / block-open seams. Emit a gap-vs-session split ONLY on Mondays and block-opens; on every other day the split is arithmetic theatre and the day-move IS the session.
proposal_1.evidence: All 20 staged sessions across g22 and g23, per-event. Sixteen weekday seams: |gap| values 0, 10, 20, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 10, 10 - maximum 20 USD, i.e. two ticks, which is the render's own resolution. Four weekend / block-open seams: 1,210 (g22 0622), 50 (g22 0629), 580 (g23 0706), 360 (g23 0713).
proposal_1.n: 20 sessions, 2 groups, spans groups. Structural rather than statistical - it follows from the ~23-hour session.
proposal_1.scope: NG continuous front-month on the staged MBO legs. Would need re-checking on any tape with a different session calendar.
proposal_1.why_it_matters: It relocates the whole gap error budget onto four days in twenty and tells the coordinator which days need a split scored separately at all.
proposal_1.falsifier: A weekday seam with |gap| >= 100 USD absent a session-calendar change.

proposal_2.id: boundary.weekend_gap_wide_band_emission - SPLIT THE SIGN FROM THE BAND
proposal_2.claim: The play currently fuses a sign claim to a magnitude band and emits a one-sided band. Split it: emit the gap MAGNITUDE as a signless band from the sigma x book-state rung, and emit the gap SIGN as a separate, separately-scored instrument. Score the two independently.
proposal_2.evidence: My day is the clean demonstration. The magnitude arm was RIGHT (|actual gap| 580 sits inside the |150..700| band the play derived from a 0.5-1.0x era-degraded sigma, and the mid-book rung was correctly preferred to the 1.5-2.5x extreme rung). The sign arm was WRONG. Because the band is one-sided, a correct magnitude read scored as a 730 USD miss outside the near edge. Across the four weekend seams in g22+g23, the |150..700| band would contain |gap| on 2 of 4 (580, 360) and miss 2 (1,210, 50) - so the band's width is mediocre on its own and its usable content is being destroyed by a sign error it does not need to carry.
proposal_2.falsifier: A group in which the fused emission scores better than the split emission on gap error - i.e. where the sign and magnitude arms are genuinely correlated.

proposal_3.claim: SCOPE REFINEMENT to C's numb-class rule (which I corroborate out-of-sample), not a competing rule. A numb prior-session terminal coefficient bounds the next day's NET and says nothing useful about its RANGE. It is a net-suppressor, not a volatility-suppressor. A desk sizing a quiet day off it will be right about the close and badly wrong about the path.
proposal_3.evidence: Numb seams in g22+g23 (|k3_prev| <= 0.05), per instance: 0703->0706 net +100 on a range of 970 (ratio 9.7) with a 960 USD turn and a low 840 below the anchor; 0713->0714 net +200 range 780 (3.9); 0714->0715 net -60 range 760 (12.7); 0715->0716 net -20 range 1,450 (72.5). Against the non-numb days in the same two groups: median |net| 520 and median range 1,350, ratios 1.2 to 5.0. The numb class compresses the NET by 6.5x (median |net| 80 vs 520) but the RANGE by only 1.5x (875 vs 1,350). CORROBORATION of C's underlying rule: my seam is an independent instance in a day-class C did not sample (a 3-night holiday seam Monday) and it lands in class at +100 <= 200; all four numb seams in g22+g23 land in class.
proposal_3.n: 4 numb instances measured here spanning g22-g23, against a 15-session non-numb comparison in the same two groups. C reports further instances in g20, so the underlying rule spans three groups.
proposal_3.declared_weakness: My own instance measures k3_prev on 489 lots against C's stated >=500-lot floor. It is a boundary instance by 2 percent and should be counted as such.
proposal_3.scope: Next-day NET only. Explicitly silent on sign (C's own refusal, which I keep) and now explicitly silent on range.
proposal_3.falsifier: A numb seam (|k3_prev| <= 0.05, |ph3 flow| >= 500) whose next session both nets >= 700 USD and does so without an exogenous catalyst - which would break the net claim; or a run of numb seams whose ranges compress as hard as their nets, which would break this refinement.

proposal_4.id: monday.catchup_window_is_a_sell_window_not_a_ratification_window - RETIRE the ratification arm of the B lens
proposal_4.claim: The 06:00-10:00 ET Monday window does not ratify or reverse the overnight according to the overnight's sign. On the available evidence it contributes negatively regardless of the day's direction, and it is not where Monday's magnitude is decided. Retire the ratification arm; keep the window as a small, one-sided drag term; move the lens's attention to the seam.
proposal_4.evidence: Four Mondays, both staged groups, measured off the realized continuous curves: 0622 -710, 0629 -510, 0706 -50, 0713 -360. Negative 4 of 4, median -435. The two adjacent sub-periods each split 2-2 (pre-06 +500/-490/+390/-100; 10-close -350/-160/+340/+200), so the window is the only unanimous sub-period of a Monday. It is negative on both Mondays that closed UP on the day, i.e. it trades against the day's own direction. On 0706 it contributed -50 of a +880 advance, all of which arrived outside the window.
proposal_4.scope: Regular and block-open Mondays on the staged NG legs.
proposal_4.declared_confound: g22 and g23 sit inside one continuous downtrend (3.319 -> 2.916). A unanimous sell window across two groups of one regime may be a regime sample, not a structure. This is the reason the proposal is worded as 'retire the ratification arm' (which is 0 for 2 and cannot be rescued by regime) rather than 'the window sells' (which can).
proposal_4.falsifier: An up-trending fortnight in which the Monday 06-10 window is positive on 2 or more Mondays.

proposal_5.id: weather.burn_conversion_gate - CONCUR WITH WITHDRAWAL of the confirmation limb
proposal_5.claim: Adding my day's adjudication to the four already filed. The gate's CDD-add limb is positive on 9 of 10 g23 days and so cannot gate anything in a summer block; the burn limb rose 19 percent across g23 (42.9 -> 51.0 Bcf/d) while price fell 10 percent (-3,290 USD); and my day - the block's LOWEST burn reading, used as an up-confirm licensing a +400..+800 day - delivered +100 with its one decisive directional move (the -580 seam) going against the gate. Withdraw the confirmation/amplitude limb. Do NOT invert it: one block showing the gate carries no directional information is not a demonstration that burn is bearish.
proposal_5.n: 10 days in g23 measured here; five specialists concurring across the group.
proposal_5.scope: Summer/CDD-regime blocks. The winter/HDD form is untested here and should not be retired by this evidence.
proposal_5.falsifier: A block in which the burn limb fires on fewer than half the days AND the up-fires deliver at their licensed magnitude class.

hypothesis_not_a_proposal.statement: A price move made inside a holiday half-session or otherwise thin session is made by the participants who were present; the seam is when the absent majority prices it. The rally-quality give-back rung should therefore be applied to the SEAM, not to the following session.
hypothesis_not_a_proposal.the_single_instance: 0703 closed +410 on -1,005 net aggressor sell across all three phases, absorb_session TRUE, on 11,501 trades against a ~37,000 full-session median. The next seam gapped -580 - 141 percent of the entire 0703 gain, and more than the 50-70 percent rung would support (-205..-287).
hypothesis_not_a_proposal.why_it_is_filed_as_a_hypothesis: n=1. The only other half-sessions in g22+g23 are the Fridays 0710 and 0717, which carry full trade counts (47,552 and 26,930) and so are not the same object. I flip my own gap sign on this reading because the causal evidence on my day is unambiguous, and I refuse to promote it to a rule on one instance. It needs a second holiday or genuinely thin session feeding a seam before it is worth anyone's forward test.
hypothesis_not_a_proposal.falsifier: A thin session (trade count <= 40 percent of the full-session median) whose move is EXTENDED rather than given back at the next seam.

summary: One day owned: 20260706, a block-open Monday after a 3-night holiday seam. HEADLINE: the blind's scored result (+500 vs +100, 'direction right, magnitude 5x') is a cancellation artifact. The gap was +400 forecast against -580 actual - wrong sign, 980 error - and the session was +100 forecast against +680 actual - right sign, 580 error. Component error 1,560 against a day-level score of 400; the day-level number hid 74 percent of the failure. POSTERIOR: day-move +100 (direction unchanged from the blind, magnitude re-derived), split gap -290 / session +390, path re-levelled and honestly under-amplitude. THE INSTRUMENT: k3_prev, the prior session's terminal-phase impact coefficient, computed from 0703's phase table as |+20|/|-489| = 0.041 - NUMB, ceiling |day move| <= 200. My blind's +500 was 2.5x outside a bound that was fully computable before the reopen. The directive's premise that my day is 'pre-void, high impact' is wrong: 0703's terminal phase was already numb, from holiday thinness rather than from a liquidity void - two roads into the same coefficient. The coefficient explains the whole magnitude miss on the NET and none of the internals: a 970 range, a 960 turn and a -840 low sat inside a +100 day, because a numb coefficient suppresses the net 6.5x and the range only 1.5x. BURN GATE: refuted on my day too, four independent ways - the CDD limb is positive 9/10 days in g23, burn rose 19 percent across the block while price fell 10 percent, my day carries the block's LOWEST burn reading and got used as an up-confirm, and the one decisive move went against it. WIDE-BAND EMISSION: magnitude arm right (|580| inside |150..700|), sign arm wrong, and because the band is one-sided the correct magnitude read scored as a 730 miss - split the sign from the band. MY OWN LENS: refuted. The 06-10 catch-up window is negative on 4 of 4 Mondays across both staged groups, including both Mondays that closed up; on my day it contributed -50 of an +880 advance. The ratification arm is 0 for 2 and should be retired, with the downtrend confound declared.
